english.note: Use this all-purpose spoken choice for something completed or happening on schedule and not late.

exampleSentences.english: We started the meeting at eight, which was timely.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zeon2 si4 baat3 dim2 hoi1 wui2

english.note: Use this specifically when someone arrives or does something at the scheduled time.

exampleSentences.english: They are always prompt and never make anyone wait.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢次次都準時到，從來唔使人等。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 ci3 ci3 dou1 zeon2 si4 dou3 cung4 loi4 m4 sai2 jan4 dang2

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an event happening on time or a person arriving or acting on time.

exampleSentences.english: The train is punctual and leaves at seven.
exampleSentences.jyutping: baan1 fo2 ce1 zeon2 si4 cat1 dim2 hoi1 ceot1
